Package com.example.savings_app.service

Class MilestoneService

java.lang.Object
com.example.savings_app.service.MilestoneService
@Service public class MilestoneService extends Object
Service class responsible for handling the business logic related to milestones. It includes operations such as creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting milestones.
